data.exact_reserve_text: An overall deterioration of GBP 0.1 million on prior years' provisions was experienced during the year. This is due to deteriorations of GBP 0.4 million on casualty reinsurance and GBP 0.2 million on marine reinsurance partially offset by an improvement of GBP 0.5 million on property reinsurance.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a significant gross prior year strengthening of GBP 28.019 million, representing 76.23% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This strengthening primarily arose from the 2018 and 2019 underwriting years, as calculated from the gross claims development triangle. While the report's narrative mentions an overall deterioration of GBP 0.1 million on prior years' provisions, attributed to deteriorations in casualty and marine reinsurance partially offset by improvements in property reinsurance, this figure is inconsistent with the gross triangle. Key events impacting the year included the COVID-19 pandemic, the active 2020 Atlantic hurricane season, Australian bushfires (starting in 2019), Tennessee tornadoes, and Hurricane Laura.
